**方案A：清理后继续pick**

- 每个pick后验证，避免累积冲突

#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================
# 方案A：从 v-stable-20260517 重建，严格分批 cherry-pick
# 用法：bash rebuild_from_17.sh
# 注意：执行前确保工作区干净
# ============================================================

set -e
BASE="v-stable-20260517"
NEW_BRANCH="progressive-fixes"

echo "=== 1. 从 $BASE 创建新分支 ==="
git checkout -b "$NEW_BRANCH" "$BASE"

echo ""
echo "=== 2. 第一批：纯bug修复（12个） ==="
# 注意：有些commit已在当前分支上有二次修改版本
# 这里用原始commit（17→23范围内的）

PURE_FIXES=(
  "46cf083"  # fix(tool_loop): degenerate repetition loops
  "f5f44dd"  # fix(broadcast): consecutive LLM errors
  "8e58eb1"  # fix: end_discussion guard
  "c734792"  # fix: restore head_indices recalculation
  "6f6e835"  # fix: restore max_chars getters
  "4ac4fda"  # fix: cap _request_log at 1000
  "3b9a145"  # test: update localhost test
  "fc4f504"  # refactor: allow loopback URLs
  "bede0b0"  # fix: safety guard false positives
  "778c00c"  # fix(broadcast): synthesis after end_discussion
  "3890140"  # fix(broadcast): leader_end_event check
  "75d0179"  # fix: boolean parsing + auto-discover scripts
)

for SHA in "${PURE_FIXES[@]}"; do
  echo "  -> cherry-pick $SHA"
  if ! git cherry-pick "$SHA" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "  [冲突] $SHA — 手动解决后继续"
    exit 1
  fi
done

echo ""
echo "=== 3. 第二批：slot泄漏+deadlock（用当前分支二次修改版本） ==="
echo "  手动应用以下diff（而非cherry-pick原始commit）："
echo "  - 6752bf3 (slot泄漏 — 当前分支版本)"
echo "  - eb7eab7 (deadlock — 当前分支版本)"
echo "  方法：git diff <parent>..6752bf3 | git apply"
echo ""

echo "=== 4. 第三批：feature（可选，按需pick） ==="
echo "  - f0a51db (rank-based tool call isolation)"
echo "  - c5cfb74 (update litellm_provider)"
echo "  - 61b466d (synthesis retry helper)"
echo "  - 66091eb (docless skill discovery + compact mode)"

echo "  - 261219e (legend migration)"
echo "  - fd9b9a6 (visual separators)"
echo "  - 47a5cd3 (rules visualization)"
echo "  - 3790223 (fix phase alignment)"
echo "  - 513acff (fix manifest phase field)"
echo "  - 99eb8f6 (docs: send_photo_cli.py)"
echo "  - f9a3195 (remove memory_palace snapshot)"
echo ""

echo "=== 完成 ==="
echo "新分支: $NEW_BRANCH"
echo "当前分支: $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
SCRIPT
